verification.method: Manual comparison of the visible PDF page with raw text extracted independently by PyMuPDF. Classifier predictions were not used to assign labels.
verification.thai_reference_text: The existing OCR benchmark ground truth was used only as supplementary character-level evidence after manual review.

labels.good: The important fields and main text are sufficiently correct for text normalization and metadata extraction.
labels.poor: A text layer exists, but corruption, wrong character mapping, or missing important content makes direct metadata extraction unsafe.
labels.missing: No usable text layer exists, or too little text is present to continue.
